target_customer: Institutions that buy or sell GPUs and AI servers, including operators, clouds, brokers and resellers
problem: GPU and AI hardware trades are opaque and bilateral. Stoa offers reference pricing, a request for quote marketplace with verified dealers and secure settlement.
business_model: marketplace taking a fee on trades (fee not stated), acting as intermediary

competitors.name: Ornn
competitors.what: GPU compute price index and commodity market

competitors.name: Silicon Data
competitors.traction_then: CME planned futures on its indexes, pending approval

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace and settlement software is standard, with harder parts in verification, pricing indexes and potential CFTC licensing.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity among vetted dealers could compound, and a regulated exchange license would be a barrier, but the license is still pending.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Price index firms were moving toward derivatives, but no action against Stoa is reported.

market_need_then: AI compute was scarce and price-volatile in 2026, with index providers and prediction markets forming around GPU prices.

branding.name_origin: Not stated by a source; a stoa is a covered public walkway in ancient Greece, but no source links the name to this choice.
branding.domain_note: Uses stoaexchange.com and the brand also appears as Stoa Markets, so the plain .com was apparently not used.
branding.community_and_virality: Launch posted to Hacker News and covered in Turkish and other outlets; the claim of $300M+ in RFQs in month one is self-reported.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name and launch attention, but it shares the name with an unrelated online community and uses two names.

outcome_analysis: Stoa joined YC in Summer 2026, launched its RFQ marketplace on July 31, and on 2026-11-04 was reported to have received an undisclosed investment from the venture fund 212. The founders bring trading and quant backgrounds. It is Active with no exit or shutdown found. The RFQ volume claim counts requests, not completed trades.
notes: 212 round has no disclosed amount or stage, hence stage other. Aggregators list $500K pre-seed and Dealroom a $125k seed, single-aggregator and unverified. Resource Recycling mentions Decacorn Venture Capital as an investor, not verified. Cross-check on the 212 investment is the Forbes Turkiye headline seen only in search results.
